description: This file defines a specialized version of Vert.x's BasicAuthHandler, named HonoBasicAuthHandler, which adds custom exception processing and tracing support. It handles authentication via an AuthProvider, manages exceptions, and integrates OpenTracing for distributed trace context propagation.

classes.name: HonoBasicAuthHandler
classes.description: A subclass of BasicAuthHandlerImpl that adds custom exception handling and tracing integration for Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: HonoBasicAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing with an AuthProvider, realm, and Tracer object.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Overrides the method to process exceptions, ensuring proper response handling when errors occur during authentication.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Overrides credential parsing to add tracing context injection and custom error handling for malformed headers.
